newsitem.title: INDIA: India bullion closes lower on sluggish demand.
newsitem.headline: India bullion closes lower on sluggish demand.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed 20 rupees lower at 4,520 rupees amid sluggish demand and losses in the world market.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.64 gramme) closed 200 rupees lower at 52,900 rupees per piece after gaining 200 rupees on Tuesday.
** Silver (.999) closed 35 rupees lower at 6,300 rupees per kg on unloading by local stockists amid sluggish industrial buying.
